chunks: And from wherever you come out, turn your face towards the Sacred Mosque, and wherever you are, turn your faces towards it, so that people may not have an argument against you, except for those of them who are unjust; so do not fear them but fear Me, and that I may complete My favour upon you, and that you may be guided.
ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic ruling for the direction of prayer (qibla) and its significance?
ai.summary: This verse marks the pivotal transition of the qibla from Jerusalem to Mecca, a change that tested the sincerity of the believers and solidified the distinct identity of the Muslim community. In Shia scholarship, this shift is often viewed as a divine completion of favor (ikmal al-ni'mah), reinforcing the continuity of prophetic tradition while removing the 'hujjah' (argument) of the disbelievers. It underscores that true guidance comes from God alone, urging believers to focus on Him rather than the opinions of others.
